title: 'Main Na Raha Mera' First Look: Adhyayan Suman's Musical Romance Sets Teaser for September 16
excerpt: Adhyayan Suman's romantic musical pairs him with former Miss Universe India Divita Rai in a 90s-nostalgia love story built around ego versus love.
body:
• The makers of the Hindi romantic musical 'Main Na Raha Mera' unveiled the film's first look on September 12, a motion poster built around the question "Can pride be greater than love?" — with the teaser set for release on September 16.
  • The film stars Adhyayan Suman opposite Divita Rai, Miss Diva Universe 2022 who represented India at Miss Universe 2022, in what its makers present as her first acting project.
  • Created by Suman, produced by Dharmesh Sangani and directed by Amit Kasaria, the musical follows Raj, a young man shaped by 1990s Bollywood romances, who reunites with his lost love Simran 12 years later.
  • Music is by Rahul Nair, with Suman calling it "one of the finest and most soulful music albums of the year." No theatrical release date has been announced.

Bollywood's love for lost love continues. The first look of the Hindi romantic musical Main Na Raha Mera was unveiled on September 12, with a motion poster that opens on a pointed question: "Kya guroor ishq se bada ho sakta hai?" — can pride be greater than love? The teaser arrives September 16.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=a00-vyIUnHo

The film stars Adhyayan Suman opposite Divita Rai, and is being billed by its makers as Rai's first acting project. Suman — who carries a "created by" credit on the film — has described the project as "incredibly special" and "deeply close to my heart," noting that the three-year journey of making it "has changed all of us." The film is produced by Dharmesh Sangani of Sangani Brothers and directed by Amit Kasaria, with music by Rahul Nair and editing by Shubham Srivastav.

The story: a 90s romance, 12 years later

The plot follows Raj, a young man whose idea of romance was shaped by the classic love stories of 1990s Bollywood. After losing his Simran to one-sided love, Raj crosses paths with her again twelve years later — and the reunion rekindles emotions that force him to confront years of pain. The motion poster is described as a haunting glimpse into the film's emotional world of love, longing, heartbreak and ego, according to reporting by Bollywood Hungama and ANI.

https://x.com/SumitkadeI/status/2098728411384762607

Suman reserved special praise for the music, calling Rahul Nair's album "one of the finest and most soulful music albums of the year" — a bold claim for a romantic musical, where the songs will have to carry much of the emotional weight.

Divita Rai: from the pageant stage to the screen

Rai, born in Mangalore in 1998 and a trained architect from Sir J.J. College of Architecture in Mumbai, was crowned Miss Diva Universe 2022 by Harnaaz Sandhu and represented India at Miss Universe 2022 in New Orleans, placing in the Top 16 — the only Asian finalist that year.

"My character experiences emotions that are layered, some beautiful and some really difficult, and discovering that space as an actor has been really special."

— Divita Rai

"I hope audiences connect with the character's journey and see something of their own emotions in it," Rai said in the film's official announcement.

The beauty-queen-to-Bollywood pipeline

Rai's move follows one of Bollywood's most reliable traditions. Miss Universe and Miss World titleholders — from Sushmita Sen and Lara Dutta to Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Priyanka Chopra and Harnaaz Sandhu — have long been a feeder pipeline for the Hindi film industry. What makes Main Na Raha Mera interesting is the vehicle: not a splashy commercial launch but a creator-driven romantic musical, with Suman wearing the auteur hat.

The film's premise — a man raised on 90s Bollywood romance trying to live one — also plays to a wave of nostalgia in Hindi cinema, where the decade's love stories remain a cultural touchstone for both domestic and diaspora audiences.

What to watch

The September 16 teaser is the next beat: it will reveal the film's visual language, its songs and whether the central ego-vs-love question lands with audiences. Still unannounced: a theatrical or streaming release date, the trailer, and full cast and crew credits. For a film positioning itself as a soulful musical romance, the reception of Rahul Nair's score — not the first look — will likely decide its fate.
